title: Launch Core System
description: A four-image reference-dependent campaign system that locks one original launch vehicle and extends it across premium hero situations.
creative_direction: One halo vehicle identity anchors the package. Image 01 establishes the exact silhouette, surface logic, and premium launch mood. Images 02-04 depend on it and preserve the same core car while shifting environment, rhythm, and campaign emphasis.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-context-shift, 03-surface-study, 04-presentation-master. Queue may run later images concurrently after 01-reference-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
